SipBuddy 1.2.0 lets users upload and use their **existing avatar artwork**. Open **My buddy → Upload existing avatar**, choose a PNG/JPEG/WebP image, then click **Use my avatar**. The chosen image replaces the original in desktop reminders, the dashboard, and previews.

Transparent full-body PNGs work best for walking. Set the hip/knee joints and leg spacing if needed, or choose Float for portraits and other artwork. Existing transparency and proportions are preserved. Optional flat-background removal is local. No AI generation, image-service credits, or photo upload is used. The private photo-avatar mode remains available separately.

Download **SipBuddy-Setup-1.2.0.exe** below (Windows x64, per-user). Updating preserves local water history and preferences. Website and desktop avatars are stored separately, so choose your image in the Windows app for real desktop reminders.

The installer is **unsigned** and may trigger SmartScreen / unknown-publisher warnings. Automated tests cover private uploads, persistence, removal, walking configuration, input validation, migration, and the real Electron overlay using uploaded artwork. Hands-on Windows focus/click-through, mixed-DPI, and installer acceptance checks remain documented in README.md.
